items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Did you mention the John Patitucci and Jackie DeJohnette?

ctx.x: What brings about the change in personnel? Was it a recording opportunity or something musically?

I think the change in personnel is due to a couple of factors. One, it may be some of the other members that might have been contemplated to be used when not available at the time. Or, maybe they wanted to change the personnel to change the sound. They wanted a variety of sound. Because everybody can play the same tunes, the same arrangements and they will always sound different if you use different players. To me, that is what the Japanese had in mind.
